related.title: 光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統
related.titleEn: Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應」與「絕對光頻量測：序數、符號與計數」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb" and "Absolute optical-frequency measurement: mode number, signs and counting" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo、f-2f 自參考與雙迴路鎖相的梳狀雷射工程；光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統則以鍶光晶格鐘的超高真空、冷卻與鐘雷射、系統位移與 10⁻¹⁸ 級評估為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on comb engineering around f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo, f-2f self-referencing and dual-loop phase locking; Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems centres on ultrahigh vacuum, cooling and clock lasers, systematic shifts and 10⁻¹⁸-level evaluation of a strontium lattice clock, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」與「鐘躍遷品質因數與艾倫偏差」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到光學原子鐘真空與雷射系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「不確定度預算與穩定度瓶頸」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase” and “Clock-transition quality factor and Allan deviation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Optical atomic-clock vacuum and laser systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Uncertainty budget and stability bottlenecks", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 光學頻率梳穩定系統
history.text: 1999–2000 年間，Hänsch 在德國馬克斯普朗克量子光學研究所與 Hall 在美國 JILA 的團隊分別以鈦藍寶石鎖模雷射與微結構光纖實現自參考的光學頻率梳，把過去需要整個房間的諧波頻率鏈縮成一台雷射，兩人因此分享 2005 年諾貝爾物理獎。2001 年 Menlo Systems 作為 MPQ 衍生公司成立，2000 年代中期摻鉺光纖梳使頻率梳成為可全天候運轉的商用儀器；2007 年起微共振腔克爾梳開啟晶片化方向。今日頻率梳是光學原子鐘、精密光譜、天文光譜儀校正與光纖時頻傳遞的核心。本課只重建公開原理與工程方法。
history.textEn: Between 1999 and 2000 the groups of Hänsch at the Max Planck Institute of Quantum Optics in Germany and Hall at JILA in the United States realised self-referenced optical frequency combs with titanium-sapphire mode-locked lasers and microstructured fibre, shrinking harmonic frequency chains that once filled a room into a single laser, for which the two shared the 2005 Nobel Prize in Physics. Menlo Systems was founded in 2001 as an MPQ spin-off, erbium fibre combs in the mid-2000s turned the comb into a commercial instrument that runs around the clock, and from 2007 microresonator Kerr combs opened the chip-scale direction. Today combs are central to optical atomic clocks, precision spectroscopy, astronomical spectrograph calibration and fibre time-frequency transfer; this course reconstructs only public principles and engineering methods.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應」到「鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb" through "Lock quality, acceptance criteria and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
